title: On Windows the land e2e test cannot add a worker worktree of its scenario clone: Filename too long
goal: On the Windows 11 host test_land_content_item_then_planted_failure passes, and with it the whole-suite gate of kbgit.py sync --push: the worker worktree it adds under its scenario clone's .claude/worktrees/ (since 8a1e2de6) checks out every seeded file, the deepest kb/public/security/artifacts/disa STIG xml included, from a pytest temp directory under a long Windows user profile path. git_env() sets GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL to the null device and GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM, so no host setting (core.longpaths, LongPathsEnabled) reaches the scenario's git: the fix is in the repository. Found landing BG-nlp5aat5 on the Windows host (2026-10-08): sync's gate failed with 1 failed, 57 passed, nothing pushed.
